title: Terraform test agent result
description: What the test agent returns at the end of a run. The pipeline reads only this; free text from the agent is ignored.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the top of the pull request comment.

modules.description: One entry for every module the agent was asked to look at.

findings.description: Things a reviewer should know about the infrastructure code. The agent reports them and never changes that code.

limitations.description: What the tests of this run cannot show.

decision.description: tests_added: new test file(s). tests_updated: existing test file(s) changed. no_tests_needed: the change needs no new tests. skipped: the agent could not work on the module.

reason.description: Why the agent made this decision.

test_files.description: Test files the agent created or changed. Only test files are allowed.

covered_behaviours.description: What the tests check, in plain words, one behaviour per item.

final_test_status.description: The agent's own claim about its last test run. The verify job runs the tests again and compares.

severity.description: high: likely security or outage risk. medium: a real risk under some conditions. low: a weakness worth fixing. info: worth knowing, no action needed.

file.description: File that shows the problem, relative to the repository root.

line.description: Line in that file where the evidence is.

detail.description: What is wrong and why it matters.

recommendation.description: What a person could change. The agent does not make the change.

introduced_by_change.description: true when the change under review added or changed this problem; false when it existed before.

suggested_test.description: A test that fails on the current code and would pass once it is fixed, or null. It is shown to reviewers, never committed.
